senses.gloss: (= h. בּוּשׁ, cmp. רוּץ a. רְהַט) to be confounded, abashed, ashamed.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 49:8">Targ. O. Gen. XLIX, 8</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Shek. I, beg. 45ᵈ (in Hebr. phraseol.) <he>הן נקרא ולא נבהית</he> (Bab. ed. <he>הנקרא … נבעית</he>) can we read this and not feel ashamed? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:4">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:4">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top, if I rise among the righteous, <he>לא נבהת</he> I may not feel ashamed.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ומה אנא בהית בעבדאי</he> (read <he>בעובדיי</he>) why should I be ashamed of my doings? Y. Kidd. IV, 65ᶜ top <he>בָּהֲתִין וכ׳</he> they are ashamed of one another.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:3:11">Y. Orl. I, 61ᵇ</cite> top <he>בהית מסתכל ביה</he> is ashamed to look at him.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31:9">Lev. R. s. 31</cite> <he>לא בהתין</he> yet are not ashamed (to worship them).
<cite ref="Ketubot 62a:5">Keth. 62ᵃ</cite> (prov.) a woman used to abortion (or loss of children through death) <he>לא בהתה</he> is no longer besides herself (when it reoccurs; Ar.: is not ashamed).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 14:6">Targ. Ps. XIV, 6</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 119:116">Ib. CXIX, 116</cite>; a. e.—Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ bot.; Y. Maas. Sh. V, beg. 55ᵈ <he>ומבהתין ליה דיעבד</he> and bend the tree down as if in shame, in order that it may bear fruits (cmp.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> ‘that people may pray for it’). Y. Kil.; Y. Keth. l. c. if I rise among the wicked <he>לא נַבְהִית</he> (or <he>נְבָהֵת</he>) I may not put (them) to shame.

senses.gloss: to frighten, confound.—Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵃ bot. לא תבהית וכ׳ confound not thy Master’s children (the Israelites).
, contr. אִבְּהִית to be put to shame.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite> <he>והוא מתב׳ וכ׳</he> and he felt ashamed and went away. Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ top <he>מִבַּהֲתָא</he> she is ashamed.
